name: code-audit-rigor
description: Code review & audit toolkit — routine two-round review commands (/review-branch, /review-pr) sharing path-matched language rule packs, with cross-round memory (unchanged files skipped, dismissed anchors never re-posted, verified-but-unfixed findings carried), an introduced / pre-existing tag on every finding, a path-resolved risk tier, and in-thread replies that resolve review conversations; plus quantitative decision frameworks (EV calculation, score-based calibration, STRIDE+CWE classification) and deterministic engineering guarantees (mechanical scope/coverage reconciliation, quoted-code reference anchoring) for high-stakes audits where intuition is insufficient. The toolkit is auto-fix-free and injection-safe by design: it reports and verifies, never rewrites your code — for finding-to-patch work use the claude-security plugin's suggest-patches job.
